candidates.name: Threads
candidates.verdict: Large (147M DAU Jul 2026) but consumer-heavy; cross-post only

decision: X remains the highest-signal network for AI builders and devtool buyers, and the free account works. Pay for Premium Basic (~₹170/mo) only if you need longer posts/edits. Native X posting via third-party tools now depends on X's pay-per-use API (Feb 2026), so expect schedulers to restrict X features.
details: X API moved to pay-per-use in Feb 2026; legacy free tier effectively gone.

verify.note: X API pay-per-use confirmed on docs.x.com ('pay-per-usage pricing with no subscriptions'; post read $0.005, post create $0.015, with URL $0.20; $20 promo credit on first purchase). The Feb 2026 start date comes from secondary sources. | India prices are Jul 2025 (Basic Rs170, Premium Rs427, Premium+ Rs2,570 web); no 2026 price found; mobile prices higher (Premium ~Rs470). Verify on x.com before quoting.
